chain.title: Water Poured Into Light
chain.desc: Reached by building a nether-portal-shaped frame out of glowstone and pouring a water bucket into it, as the mod's own tip line states.

chain.title: First Cut in the Clouds
chain.desc: Chopped from the skyroot trees that cover the floating islands, and it is the source of every skyroot plank, stick and starter tool.

chain.title: The Bones of the Islands
chain.desc: Mined from under the Aether grass layer; the mod describes it as the Aether's native rock and it substitutes for cobblestone in tool recipes.

chain.title: Chalk-White Bite
chain.desc: Crafted from holystone and skyroot sticks, and it is the first pickaxe capable of mining zanite and icestone.

chain.title: Coal That Heals
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from Ambrosium Ore; it fuels the Altar and restores a little health when eaten.

chain.title: Violet in the Stone
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from Zanite Ore, the Aether's iron equivalent, whose tools get stronger as their durability drops.

chain.title: The Enchanting Slab
chain.desc: Crafted from holystone and a zanite gemstone, powered by Ambrosium Shards, and used for every enchanting recipe in the mod as well as armour repair.

chain.title: Sharper With Every Swing
chain.desc: Crafted from zanite gemstones and skyroot sticks; it is the tier required to mine Gravitite Ore and Golden Oak Logs.

chain.title: Purple Plate for the Descent
chain.desc: Crafted from zanite gemstones, and it is the realistic armour tier for a first Bronze Dungeon attempt.

chain.title: Sap of the Golden Oak
chain.desc: Drops when Golden Oak Logs are mined with a zanite or gravitite axe, and it is the ammunition base for darts and dart shooters.

chain.title: A Reach Advantage
chain.desc: Crafted from golden amber and skyroot planks, giving the ranged option that Zephyrs and Cockatrices demand.

chain.title: The Stone That Charges
chain.desc: The Bronze Dungeon boss, a four-hundred-health block of living stone found in dungeons buried inside the islands, and it can only be hurt by pickaxes.

chain.title: A Dull Prize
chain.desc: Dropped by the Slider along with carved stone, and it unlocks the Bronze Dungeon's locked reward chest.

chain.title: Landing Without Consequence
chain.desc: Bronze Dungeon treasure loot; wearing them removes fall damage, which matters enormously on floating islands.

chain.title: Proof You Beat a Knight
chain.desc: Dropped by lesser Valkyries when defeated, and the item's own lore says a pile of them is what proves you worthy of fighting the Valkyrie Queen.

chain.title: Audience With the Sky Warrior
chain.desc: The Silver Dungeon boss, who only accepts a duel once you hand her enough Victory Medals.

chain.title: The Reflective Key
chain.desc: Given by the Valkyrie Queen after her defeat, and it opens the Silver Dungeon's treasure room.

chain.title: Borrowed Wings of the Order
chain.desc: Found in the Valkyrie armour chests inside the Silver Dungeon, alongside the matching valkyrie tools and lance.

chain.title: The Ore That Falls Upward
chain.desc: The Aether's rarest ore; it floats when unsupported and also appears in Silver Dungeon gravitite chests.

chain.title: Charged on the Altar
chain.desc: Made by enchanting Gravitite Ore in an Altar, and it is the only material accepted by gravitite tool and armour recipes.

chain.title: The Set That Launches You
chain.desc: Crafted from Enchanted Gravitite; wearing the full set grants an extra high jump, and it is the mod's best craftable armour.

chain.title: Arguing With a Star
chain.desc: The Gold Dungeon boss, a being of pure fire and energy who guards the rarest treasure in the Aether.

chain.title: Shine on the Last Lock
chain.desc: Dropped by the Sun Spirit together with the Sun Altar, and it opens the Gold Dungeon's back treasure room.

chain.title: Cinders You Can Wear
chain.desc: Gold Dungeon treasure; the full set grants fire resistance and lava swimming, but stepping into water converts it into the obsidian set.

notes: Item set = 284 stems of assets/aether/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json in the jar; every id above is a member of that set. Only one dimension file exists (data/aether/dimension/the_aether.json), so dim:aether:the_aether is the sole dimension milestone. Portal method taken from the jar's own tip string aether.pro_tips.line.aether.glowstone_portal_forming: 'Place water into a Glowstone frame'. Boss and key wiring verified from loot tables: entities/slider.json drops aether:bronze_dungeon_key, entities/valkyrie_queen.json drops aether:silver_dungeon_key, entities/sun_spirit.json drops aether:gold_dungeon_key plus aether:sun_altar, entities/valkyrie.json drops aether:victory_medal. Armour placement verified from chests/dungeon/bronze/bronze_dungeon_neptune.json (neptune set), chests/dungeon/silver/silver_dungeon_valkyrie.json (valkyrie set), chests/dungeon/gold/gold_dungeon_treasure.json (phoenix set + life shard). All three kill: entity ids exist as entity.aether.* lang keys (slider, valkyrie_queen, sun_spirit). DROPPED: aether:aether_portal_frame was considered as the opening step but the item's own lore says it is 'Not something you're likely to find naturally' and it has no recipe or loot entry - it is only granted by the optional config option aether.common.gameplay.start_with_portal, so a glowstone-and-water dim: step is used instead. Also dropped: aether:obsidian_chestplate and the rest of the obsidian set, because they have no recipe and are produced only by a runtime conversion of worn phoenix armour in water, which no quest task can reliably check; aether:aether_portal, aether:frosted_ice and aether:unstable_obsidian, which have lang keys but no item model and are therefore not items; and the 260-odd *_trim glove model variants, which have item models but no lang key of their own. Structures present: bronze_dungeon, silver_dungeon, gold_dungeon, large_aercloud. Note that this Modrinth build is published for both the forge and neoforge loaders under one file.
